title: Missing Man, Part 4
description: Missing Man, Part 4 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Seeking Secrets, Part 1

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Return to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Well, I guess you're unofficially recuited into K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. It's a different process for each person. Me, I played games with my friends. Turned out my friends were covert operatives and the games were mission simulations. Who knew?

I'm sure Sir Ving will have more missions for you. Next time you see him, tell him, One is my hand, two is my knee.

Turn-in:

Sir Reele said, One is my hand, two is my knee? Hm...very interesting, indeed.

Level range: 45–100
